description: Hypothesis: opt-in staged8 Delta recurrence reduces prefill time relative to the staged MoE base (1729.4 tok/s), while retaining conformance, retrieval and cache behavior. Enable --tuned-prefill --delta-mode staged8 with the same FP8 target, DFlash2 draft, FP16 KV, FP32 recurrent state and accumulation, 2048-token chunks and explicit 32768-token context. Staging Q/K/V and gates in eight-token blocks changes reduction order; whole-model logits are not bitwise equivalent. Benchmark-only repacked weights and dense tile variants are not enabled. Run all seven tests with the full profile and inherit the existing goals.
